description:
Open the 'Wolf, Goat, and Cabbage' logic activity in GCompris (located in the Strategy or Logic category). Solve the puzzle by transporting the Wolf, Goat, and Cabbage to the other side of the river without leaving incompatible pairs alone (Wolf eats Goat, Goat eats Cabbage). You must capture two screenshots during the process:
1. An intermediate state where the Goat is alone on the Right bank, and the Boat has returned to the Left bank to pick up the next item. Save this to '~/Documents/river_mid_step.png'.
2. The final solved state where all items are on the Right bank. Save this to '~/Documents/river_solved.png'.
